Bún quậy THIỆN MỸ on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo. 4.7 stars, 408 reviews, under $10 a head. The locals lining up here aren't doing it for the gram.

Bún quậy is Phu Quoc's own noodle dish. You won't find it like this back home. Order it, stir it, eat it fast.
